periods.description: Ancient ruins are the source of Drag-Rides, relics, documents, and Abyss threats, making them central to national power and international conflict.
periods.principles: Nations guard ruins, excavate ancient weapons and documents, and limit access because reckless exploration can awaken Abyss disasters.
periods.classification: domestic ruins, border/ambiguous ruins, guarded ruin zones, relic/document finds.
periods.origin: Seven ruins were discovered in the world and produced the Drag-Ride era.
